title: Review symbols
notFound: This map document does not exist.
accessDenied: You do not have access to this map document.
noLibrary: This document was imported before symbol matching; import the map again to review it.
inUse: This is the version the map uses.
notInUse: This reviewed version is not used yet.
finalised: The map now uses this version.
finaliseClub: Replaces the club map's current version in place. Events that already use the map keep their copy.
finaliseEvent: Replaces this event's map with the reviewed version.
outdated: Not up to date: the current symbol library, club decisions or this map's colour order would import this map differently.
clubWide: Decisions apply club-wide: every map with the same symbol (same number, same drawing) follows them on its next import, including event maps.
readOnly: You can look at the review but not change it.
noCandidates: No library symbol is close to this one.
pendingReset: Will go back to the suggestion
jobProgress: Importing the map again with the decisions… {{percent}}%

crt.title: Cross-reference table (CRT)
crt.hint: Carry the club's decisions to OpenOrienteering Mapper and back.
crt.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MiB.
crt.previewNothing: Nothing in this file changes the review.

terrain.ready3d: Terrain: {{percent}} % of the contours have a known uphill side — enough for 3D.
terrain.readyFlat: Terrain: {{percent}} % of the contours have a known uphill side — 3D needs {{min}} %.
terrain.none: Terrain: the map has no contours, so no 3D.
terrain.over-cap: Terrain: the map is too large for this server to derive its terrain.

colours.title: Colour layers
colours.hint: The order the map's colours are drawn in, listed top first. In the IOF order every colour use stands on its IOF layer, so the course and the library's symbols never depend on how the map's colour table is ordered.
colours.orderHint: Remembered for this map across new imports. Pick the order, check the picture, then use the new version.
colours.orderClubOnly: Open the review from the club map's card to change its colour order.
colours.settingDiffers_iof: This map is set to the IOF order; this version is drawn in the map's own order.
colours.settingDiffers_source: This map is set to its own order; this version is drawn in the IOF order.
colours.fallback: The IOF layers could not be built for this map, so it is drawn in its own order.

compare.openHint: Both versions as live maps: pan and zoom one and the other follows.
compare.title: Compare

pair.label: Compare
pair.order: IOF order / the map's own order

compare.same: Both sides are the same version: nothing differs.
compare.failed: This version could not be loaded.

diff.failed: The difference could not be drawn here.

layers.title: Layers, top first
layers.noLayers: In the map's own order the colours keep the map's table and have no IOF layers. Switch to the IOF order to see them.

deviations.title: Deviations
deviations.hint: Pairs of layers the map's colour table draws the other way round from the IOF order. Kept: drawn as the map draws them. Dropped: drawn in the IOF order. By default roads and paved areas stay over the contours; every other pair is dropped. Keep or drop a pair for this map, or reset it to its default; each change builds the map again.
deviations.none: The map's colour table agrees with the IOF order.
deviations.choose: Keep or drop {{upper}} over {{lower}} for this map
